title: Arbitration Ends Coffee Contract Dispute
主要内容: An independent arbitrator ruled that Starbucks must pay more than $2.7 billion in total cash compensation for its unilateral termination of the coffee contract with Kraft Foods. The award includes compensation for the fair market value of the agreement, a premium for improper termination, and interest. Mondelet International, which spun off Kraft Foods Group in 2012, will direct the net proceeds from the award to the company. Mondelez International's legal counsel stated that the arbitrator validated their position that Starbucks breached the long-standing contractual relationship without proper compensation. The dispute ended with the arbitrator's ruling, allowing both parties to focus on future business operations. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include MDLZ.
